title: Smart Home
description: The home energy hub. Tracks monthly usage and budget, live power draw (kept up to date by the appliances as they start and stop — a cross-Thing effect), and whether it is currently a peak hour (derived from the clock).

isPeakHour.title: Peak Hour
isPeakHour.description: True during peak hours (17:00-21:00 UTC), from the clock.

setBudget.title: Set Monthly Budget
setBudget.description: Set the monthly energy budget in kWh.
setBudget.vre:effects: monthlyBudgetKWh' = kWh; output.success = true; output.monthlyBudgetKWh = monthlyBudgetKWh';
